name: Granola
desc: AI-powered meeting notes — automatically captures and summarizes your meetings.

actions.name: list_notes
actions.description: List your meeting notes with optional date filters.

actions.name: get_note
actions.description: Retrieve a single meeting note by its ID, with optional transcript.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_note
triggers.description: Triggers when a new meeting note is created in Granola.

triggers.name: updated_note
triggers.description: Triggers when an existing meeting note is updated in Granola (e.g. summary edited, attendees changed).
